div.div: One binary: a custom OpenTelemetry Collector. Each machine runs an agent; an optional gateway merges machines. Everything leaves as standard OTLP to your own backend.

switch.text: One binary: a custom OpenTelemetry Collector. Each machine runs an agent; an optional gateway merges machines. Everything leaves as standard OTLP to your own backend.

div.div:
Claude Code
metrics · events · beta traces

Session files
transcripts · settings · task
invocations; read locally,
never exported

ember processor
harness match · re-parent ·
enrich · MCP split ·
privacy allowlist
(+ memory_limiter,
deltatocumulative, batch)

exporters
otlphttp / otlp,
one per signal

Traces · metrics · logs
Tempo · Prometheus · Loki,
or any OTLP intake

Dashboards
Grafana: Agent tree ·
Overview · Tools and
MCP · Cost

Other machines
ember agent, same setup

ember gateway
optional · token + TLS · spawn
links across machines · privacy
